mapper.insert: insert into academy( academy_no, academy_name, academy_tagline, academy_intro, academy_phone, academy_address, academy_wtime ) values( #{academyNo}, #{academyName}, #{academyTagline}, #{academyIntro}, #{academyPhone}, #{academyAddress}, systimestamp )
mapper.update: update academy set academy_name = #{academyName}, academy_tagline = #{academyTagline}, academy_intro = #{academyIntro}, academy_phone = #{academyPhone}, academy_address = #{academyAddress}, academy_etime = systimestamp where academy_no = #{academyNo}
mapper.select: select attach_no from academy_file where academy_no = #{academyNo} order by attach_no asc
